guidance.summary: Mobile volumes expected between 33-34 million units in FY27 excluding Vivo
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: with the outlook for H2, we feel we should be somewhere around 33-34 million. And in this, I am not including the Vivo quantities.

guidance.summary: Vivo JV expected to produce 20-21 million units in FY28
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We feel that in the JV we should be doing around 20-21 million.

guidance.summary: Production for new Indian brand customer targeted at 8-10 million units
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We feel that for that customer, next year, we should be doing almost 8 to 10 million.

guidance.summary: IT hardware revenue projected at INR 6,000-6,500 crores for FY27
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
guidance.quote: this year we are looking at a volume of closer to 1.3-1.4 million, which will translate into revenues of closer to INR 6,000-6,500 crores.

guidance.summary: IT hardware business potential of INR 15,000-20,000 crores in two years
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We feel that in next couple of years, this is going to be almost INR 15,000 crore to INR 20,000 crore business for us.

guidance.summary: IT hardware volume targeted at 1.8-2 million units in FY28
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: we feel confident that we should be touching a number of almost 1.8 to 2 million units next year.

guidance.summary: Q Tech revenue targeted between INR 2,500-3,000 crores in FY28
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
guidance.quote: broadly we should be in a kind of a number of almost somewhere between INR 2,500 crores to INR 3,000 odd crores.

guidance.summary: Display business potential revenue of INR 6,000-7,000 crores when ramped up
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
guidance.quote: the real potential for display business, once it is completely ramped up in next couple of years, it can generate revenues of closer to INR 6,000 crores to INR 7,000 crores.

guidance.summary: Targeting 80-100 bps margin expansion in display and camera modules
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
guidance.quote: we feel that over a period of next 2 years, we should be able to expand our margins by 80 to 100 bps.

guidance.summary: Telecom segment margins expected in the 3-3.2% range
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: In telecom also, Rahul, the margins in telecom, the margins are going to be in the range of around 3 to 3.2%.

guidance.summary: Company expects to close FY27 with total capex of INR 1,200 crores
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
guidance.quote: So we should close the year with INR 1,200 crores.

guidance.summary: FY28 capex run rate expected between INR 1,200-1,300 crores
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
guidance.quote: broadly that should be the run rate for next year financial year as well, somewhere between INR 1,200-1,300 odd crores.

guidance.summary: Total mobile volumes including Vivo targeted at 55-60 million in FY28
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: And with Vivo, I think it should be a decent number of somewhere between total number of 55 to 60 odd million.
